analysis.title: Software Snippets | Europe: Reporting Back from Barcelona
key_insights: MS hosted 8 fireside chats at its 2026 European TMT conference in Barcelona. Focus was on AI, with the debate for Software & Services heading into 2027 seen as greater enterprise adoption of AI in a multi-model, agentic architecture automating complex end-to-end tasks.

Companies said they want to move pricing toward outcome-based models as they deliver outcomes rather than tools. Management teams also said revenue growth can decouple from headcount growth, with leverage in R&D, G&A and S&M. MS argues revenue and profit per FTE should become tracked metrics.

Dassault held its 2026 Capital Markets Day on Tuesday and refreshed mid-term targets. Priorities are AI-driven customer value, a more recurring subscription model and better execution in Life Sciences. 2029 targets include double-digit revenue and EPS growth, revenue above €8bn, 35%+ operating margin and non-IFRS EPS of €1.80.

Investor feedback on Dassault was mixed. Bulls like the 2027 organic growth setup (MSe c. 5.3%) and stronger Life Sciences confidence. Skeptics doubt double-digit growth in 2029 and want clarity on subscription versus licence and maintenance revenue mix.

Sabre guided at its investor day to mid-single-digit growth in Marketplace bookings and group revenue in 2027, broadly in line with Visible Alpha median consensus of c. 4% air bookings growth at Amadeus. Sabre targets mid-single-digit GDS growth through 2030 from share gains, low-cost carriers and NDC re-intermediation. Share gains would likely have to come from Amadeus or Travelport.

Sabre expects agentic AI channels to deliver unit revenue and margin similar to or accretive to today's. MS says this is consistent with its view that AI agents strengthen the case for GDS intermediaries (read-across positive for Amadeus, rated Overweight).

IONOS named SAP Chief Customer Officer Thomas Saueressig as future CEO from April 2027, succeeding Achim Weiß. MS thinks it surprised both IONOS and SAP investors, since he became SAP's first CCO in April 2026. MS sees a good skill fit and no change in IONOS strategy.

Fortnox, taken private by EQT and First Kraft in 2025, plans SEK 5bn (c. €450m) of AI and technology investment over five years and a restructuring of 200 positions, about a fifth of its last disclosed workforce. It follows a £100m restructuring at Sage Group this week, a sign of software firms rethinking workforce needs.
Week ahead: Autodesk 3Q27 results, HBX Group 4Q26 results, Workday 3Q27 results, Web Travel Group 1H27 results and the Computacenter CMD (Exhibit 3 lists dates 23/11 to 27/11/2026).

Sub-sector performance table shows Application Software & IT Services down 20% over the past 2 months (as-of Thursday's close) and Neoclouds down 58% over 2 months. Data, Infrastructure & Cyber Software is down 12% over 2 months. Hyperscalers & Cloud is down 14% over 2 months.

MS coverage ratings and targets: Overweight on Amadeus (€66), Informa (1,110p), IONOS (€40), Sage (1,295p) and SAP (€235). Underweight on Netcompany (DKK 320), Temenos (CHF 67) and Tieto (€16.10). Equal-weight on Capgemini, Dassault, HBX, Nemetschek, RELX and Wolters Kluwer.

market_movers.rationale: Sabre's GDS recovery guide and view that agentic AI strengthens GDS intermediaries are read-across positives for Amadeus.
Equal-weight after CMD. Investor views are mixed on 2029 double-digit growth target and subscription mix.
CFO spoke at the conference. CCO Saueressig leaves for IONOS CEO role from April 2027, a surprise to SAP investors.

sector_views.rationale: MS Industry View is In-Line. AI adoption and outcome-based pricing are a large value pool, but investors remain sceptical on some outer-year targets.

earnings_insights: Dassault FY26 guidance: total revenue growth 4-5% cc, adj. EBIT margin 32.5-32.7%, EPS €1.35-1.36 (company guidance). MSe 2027 organic revenue growth c. 5.3%.
Sabre 2027 guidance (company, at investor day): mid-single-digit growth in Marketplace bookings and group revenue.
SAP FY26 guidance (company): cloud revenue towards upper end of €25.8-26.2bn, non-IFRS operating profit €11.8-12.2bn, FCF c. €10bn. Total revenue growth expected to accelerate in 2027.
Sage guides FY27 organic total revenue growth in the region of 10% (company guidance).
Amadeus FY26 guidance (company): likely at the lower end of mid to high single-digit cc revenue growth, adj. EBIT margin stable (FY25: 29.1%), FCF €1.35-1.45bn.
Week-ahead results: Autodesk 3Q27 and Workday 3Q27, HBX Group 4Q26 and Web Travel Group 1H27. Computacenter holds a CMD.
risk_factors: Investor scepticism over Dassault's ability to deliver double-digit growth in 2029.
Sabre's share-gain ambitions in GDS would likely come at the expense of Amadeus or Travelport.
AI-driven disruption and workforce restructuring across software, as seen at Fortnox and Sage.
Executive turnover risk at SAP after the CCO departure.
